candidates.change_summary: Change betLimit assignment to betLimit = amount + 1, making the stored limit differ from the accepted wager amount.
Delete the require guard in onlyOwner so AdjustBetAmounts can be called by non-owners.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from AdjustDifficulty so any caller can change the difficulty.
Delete the difficulty assignment in AdjustDifficulty so the state variable is not updated.
Delete the DifficultyChanged event emission in AdjustDifficulty while still updating difficulty.
Change the onlyOwner guard to require the caller to be the whale address instead of the owner.
Changed the wager value check from equality to inequality.
Changed the duplicate-wager guard to allow any existing wager value instead of only zero.
Changed the recorded timestamp from the current block number to zero.
Changed the recorded wager amount from the sent value to zero.
Deleted the Wager event emission.
Changed the real-people guard to accept any sender.
Changed the open-to-public guard to check msg.sender instead of the openToPublic flag.
Removed the require that the block number must have increased, so play() no longer reverts in the else branch.
Changed the play() condition from blockNumber < block.number to <=, so a wager in the current block can now be played instead of reverting.
Changed the payout condition from equality with difficulty / 2 to equality with difficulty, changing when payout() versus loseWager() is invoked.
Changed the modulo divisor in the winning-number computation from difficulty to difficulty + 1, altering the random outcome distribution.
Changed the loser payout amount from betLimit / 2 to betLimit, changing the ETH sent to the whale on a losing play.
Moved the timestamps[msg.sender] = 0 state update to after the payout/loseWager external call, so the timestamp is still set during those calls.
Moved the wagers[msg.sender] = 0 state update to after the payout/loseWager external call, so the wager record is present during those calls.
Moved the wagers[msg.sender] = 0 state update before the timestamps[msg.sender] = 0 update, changing the intermediate state visible during the external call.
Changed the isOpenToPublic guard from require(openToPublic) to require(true), removing the gating of play/wager by the openToPublic flag.
Changed the onlyRealPeople guard from require(msg.sender == tx.origin) to require(msg.sender != tx.origin), allowing only contract callers instead of only EOAs.
Changed the onlyPlayers guard from require(wagers[msg.sender] > 0) to require(wagers[msg.sender] >= 0), allowing players with no wager to call play().
